t: Breaking the Adobe Tax: A Practical Guide to Software Freedom
s: This article advocates for digital sovereignty through embracing free and open-source software (FOSS), primarily by leveraging the Unix terminal. It contrasts proprietary, subscription-based software like Adobe Creative Cloud with FOSS alternatives, emphasizing how learning foundational tools like the terminal grants long-term freedom from vendor lock-in and costly recurring fees.
sub: The Unix Terminal as a Gateway to Independence
Critique of Proprietary Software and Subscription Models (Adobe Tax)
Practical Introduction to Terminal Commands (pwd, cd, ls)
